描述_EN: the teenage mutant ninja turtles have been a hugely popular world-wide phenomenon, originating from a comic book in the early 1980s. there has been a large array of ninja turtles merchandise, with these types of figurines originally produced in 1987 for the first tv series and then re-marketed and updated for a new wave of fans early in the 2000s. a television cartoon series and films followed in the late 1980s-1990s and an animated film was released in 2007.
描述_ZN: 青少年变种忍者龟在世界范围内大受欢迎，起源于20世纪80年代初的一本漫画书。 有大量的忍者龟商品，这些类型的小雕像最初是在1987年为第一部电视连续剧生产的，然后在2000年代初为新一波的粉丝重新营销和更新。 在20世纪80年代末至90年代，电视动画片系列和电影相继问世，一部动画电影在2007年上映。
